//: JWT configuration template implementing docs/13_Security_Design.md#authentication-architecture and SRS-AUTH-004 (docs/04_Functional_Requirements.md#authentication). Signing keys themselves live in Vault (security/vault-integration-plan.md), never here — this file is the algorithm/TTL/claims CONTRACT every service's JWT verification middleware must implement identically.

revocation.description: Every access token's `sub`+`iat` is checked against the user_session table on each request (docs/09_Database_Dictionary.md#user_session) — a revoked session's tokens are rejected even before natural expiry, closing the gap a pure-JWT-stateless approach would leave for 'log out all devices' (SRS-AUTH-008).

storage.mobile: OS secure keychain/keystore, never AsyncStorage/plain preferences
